All dependencies and metadata are appropriate for a desktop application built on Electron or similar frameworks (e.g., access to audio, GUI, printing, secrets backend). While the package is distributed as a prebuilt binary (which limits source-level auditing), there is no indication of malicious intent in the metadata itself. The package follows common AUR conventions and poses no inherent security risk based on this file.
